item.tib: yid bzhin nor bu'i smon lam rnam dag
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni skye sgo gcod pa nas byung ba bcas / smon lam 'dus pa rnams rdzogs so // ces pa 'di yang 'di phyi nang la phan pa'i phyir du bde ldan smin grol bkra shis 'khyil gyi sgom gra ru par du bsgrub pa'o
item.note: this is an anthology of excerpts from scriptures, and the text calls itself at the end "smon lam 'dus pa," which means 'collection of prayers.' the cover-title text seems to come to an end on fol. 6v3. on fol. 6v5, we find the title rnam rgyal gtor ma'i smon lam (colophon, fol. 9r4: zhes rnam rgyal gyi chu gtor ma smon lam gnyen thing gter ma'o). on fol. 9r4 is the title sa bcu'i smon lam, ending on fol. 17v3, with the colophon: ces sa bcu lam bgrod kyi smon lam 'di ni khri rje mdo mang las byung ba rdzogs so. the text which follows has no title. the final colophon is the one given above. the order of pages is uncertain.
